title: Dictionary-Guided Mutation Operators for Automated HDL Repair
abstract: arXiv:2609.01775v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated repair of Hardware Description Language (HDL) designs remains challenging due to the large search space of candidate repairs and the strict syntactic and semantic constraints imposed by HDL grammars. Generic mutation strategies overwhelmingly generate syntactically invalid candidates that waste compilation and simulation budget, while synthesis-driven and template-based approaches impose their own constraints on generality and portability. In this paper, we propose a dictionary-guided HDL repair system that combines ANTLR-derived DUT-specific mutation vocabularies with a simulation-divergence fault localization (FL) module. The mutation operator applies category-constrained token substitutions, insertions, and deletions directly to Verilog source via regex-based matching, without requiring AST manipulation or synthesis. The FL module identifies diverging output wires from a single simulation run and scores source lines by str

translated_title: 面向硬件描述语言（HDL）自动修复的词典引导变异算子
translated_abstract: 自动修复硬件描述语言（HDL）设计仍然具有挑战性，原因在于候选修复方案的搜索空间庞大，且HDL语法施加了严格的句法和语义约束。通用的变异策略绝大多数会生成句法无效的候选方案，从而浪费编译和仿真预算；而基于综合的方法和基于模板的方法则在通用性和可移植性方面存在自身的限制。本文提出了一种词典引导的HDL修复系统，该系统将ANTLR派生的针对被测设计（DUT）的特定变异词汇表与仿真分歧故障定位（FL）模块相结合。该变异算子通过基于正则表达式的匹配，直接在Verilog源代码上执行类别约束的词法单元替换、插入和删除操作，无需AST操作或综合。故障定位模块从单次仿真运行中识别出出现分歧的输出信号线，并据此对源代码行进行评分……
tldr: 提出了一种结合ANTLR派生的DUT特定变异词典与仿真分歧故障定位模块的词典引导HDL自动修复系统，通过类别约束的令牌级变异直接修改Verilog源代码，避免了无效候选方案对编译和仿真资源的浪费。
en_tdlr: Proposes a dictionary-guided HDL repair system that combines ANTLR-derived DUT-specific mutation vocabularies with simulation-divergence fault localization, applying category-constrained token mutations directly to Verilog source code to avoid wasting compilation and simulation budgets on syntactically invalid candidates.
